items.title: Difference Between Traditional Programming and Machine Learning (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Difference Between Traditional Programming and Machine Learning' under topic 6.3 (PDF 78-79, printed 74-75).

blocks.text: Traditional (riwayati, purani tarz ki) programming mein programmer fixed rules (muqarrar qawaid) likhta hai, aur program in rules par chal kar output deta hai. Machine learning mein fixed rules ki jagah data istemal hota hai: system data se rules khud seekhta hai. Traditional programming mein kuch badalna ho to naya code likhna parta hai; machine learning mein tabdeeli naye data se aati hai. Is liye machine learning complex (pecheeda) masle behtar sambhalti hai aur nayi suraton mein dhal jati hai. Figure 6.3 dono ka farq dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Do panel. Traditional Programming (neela): Fixed Rules naam ki checklist se teer Rules wale dabbe mein, jo neeche Data naam ke database ki taraf ishara karta hai; bullets: Databases aur Spreadsheets. Machine Learning (narangi): databases se teer aik monitor (nateeje) ki taraf; neeche Data se neural network (Model) aur phir Output; bullet: Patterns from Data (data se naqsh).
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Riwayati programming aur machine learning (kitab ki Figure 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Machine Learning panel mein network ki tasveer ke gird Data, Output, Model aur Output ke labels hain; monitor par text ki lines, tick ke nishan aur chhota line graph hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek program F = 1.8C + 32 se Celsius ko Fahrenheit mein badalta hai. Yeh traditional programming hai ya machine learning? Machine learning yahi rule kaise seekh sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh traditional programming hai: rule programmer ne khud likha. Machine learning model ko Celsius aur Fahrenheit ke bohat se jore diye jayein to linear regression se woh taqreeban 1.8 ka slope (dhalaan) aur taqreeban 32 ka intercept khud seekh leta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 6.3 Overview of Machine Learning

items: Machine learning: system haath ke likhe rules ki bajaye data se patterns seekhta hai.
Model training aur naye data se behtar hota rehta hai.
Traditional: rules + data se output; machine learning: data (aur misalon) se rules (model).
